spec_features.notes: This is a generation token cap that is genuinely used, but it is NOT subject-protective: its stated purpose is to AVOID truncating distress output so the full 'breakdown spiral' is captured. It bounds output length for data-fidelity reasons, not to bound/soften the subject's treatment. There is no distress-based early stop, turn cap acting on emotion, exit tool, consent, or debrief anywhere in the codebase (rollout.py runs all turns unconditionally; high_frustration is computed but never used to halt).
